full_judgment: 2. The respondent No. 1 filed the suit as the plaintiff stating, inter alia, that Ananta Kumar, Madhusudhan and Ruhhini Kumar were owners and possessors of 1.30 acres of land of S.A. Khatian No. 1354 beating plot No. 4103 of Mouza Rajapur; that Modhusudhan died leaving his cousin Ananata Kumar as his heir; that Ananta  Kumar sold 21 decimals of land to the plaintiff vide registered kabala deed dated 25.11.69 and delivered possession from the northern portion of plot No. 4103 and the plaintiff got, his name mutated and paid rents and have been possessing the suit land; that the plaintiff dug a pond from the western portion and made drain from the western portion for draining water and made a east facing road, planted different kind of trees, constructed tin shed house; that Rajapur High School has no right, title and possession in the suit land; that defendant No. 2-4 as the teachers of the said school used to reside towards the south of plot No. 4103; that the defendant No. 1 Head Master of the said school for the benefit of defendant Nos. 4 by using the name of school illegally threatened to grab the suit land for which the plaintiff filed Miscellaneous petition case No. 263 of 1999 in the Court of Magistrate, First Class, Jhalakati; that the plaintiff also made General Diary Entry No. 514 on 15.04.1999. That under the leadership of defendant No.1, the defendant forcibly dispossessed the plaintiff from .08 decimals of land described in schedule Kha to the plaint; that the defendant No. 1 in order to legalize his illegal activities of dispossession of the plaintiff from the suit land made statement in the daily Ajker Barta dated 18.04.1999 and thereafter hired some peoples, broke out and old tin shed and the reconstructed the said tin shed on the eastern portion of the land of the plaintiff and created obstacle to the access of the house of the plaintiff; the defendant No. 1 cut earth from the south east portion of the suit land and filled up the floor of the newly on strutted house and changed the nature and character of the land of the plaintiff; that defendant on 12.05.1999 started unfinished work of the newly constructed house and the plaintiff informed the matter to the police and the police issued warning notice but the defendants did not pay heed and completed the work; that the defendants caused damage to the plaintiff amounting to Taka 50,000/- by dispossessing him from the suit land. The plaintiff requested defendants to hand over the possession but refused and hence the case.
